description.ru: Ядро SDK для игры на ManyPlay.
description.en: ManyPlay headless core runtime, auth, configs and player profile.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay headless core runtime, auth, configs and player profile. Optional modules are selected separately.

description.en: Base web platform for ManyPlay games. Publisher adapters extend this platform in separate platform-web packages.

modules.llmDescription: Base web platform for ManyPlay games. Publisher adapters extend this platform in separate platform-web packages. Select the adapter for the target publisher and read its documentation for methods and events.

description.en: ManyPlay client SDK: опциональная платформа Cordova.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay client SDK: опциональная платформа Cordova. Select platform-cordova when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.ru: Пакет profile-pack: KV, сохранения и UI профиля; headless-профиль встроен в core.
description.en: Select package profile-pack for player KV, game state and profile UI; headless profile belongs to core.

modules.llmDescription: Select package profile-pack for player KV, game state and profile UI. Headless profile belongs to core and works without declaring it: never add profile to sdk.modules. The profile-pack package includes kv, gamestate and profile-ui runtimes; Studio selects and configures the package id profile-pack.

description.en: ManyPlay ads module (sdk.ads): mediator adapter port, ad pool and rotation, isAvailable decisions, the rewarded offer cycle over sdk.iap; fake mediator for dev/test builds.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay ads module (sdk.ads): mediator adapter port, ad pool and rotation, isAvailable decisions, the rewarded offer cycle over sdk.iap; fake mediator for dev/test builds. Select mod-ads-web when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.en: ManyPlay ads module (sdk.ads): mediator adapter port, ad pool and rotation, isAvailable decisions, the rewarded offer cycle over sdk.iap; fake mediator for dev/test builds.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay ads module (sdk.ads): mediator adapter port, ad pool and rotation, isAvailable decisions, the rewarded offer cycle over sdk.iap; fake mediator for dev/test builds. Select mod-ads-mobile when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.en: ManyPlay in-app purchases: offers from configs iap.*, orders of the iap service, StoreAdapter port and the fake store of test/dev builds.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay in-app purchases: offers from configs iap.*, orders of the iap service, StoreAdapter port and the fake store of test/dev builds. Select mod-iap when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.en: ManyPlay player inventory projection and exchange by server rule.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay player inventory projection and exchange by server rule. Select mod-inventory when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.
ManyPlay client leaderboards module. Select mod-leaderboards when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.ru: Прогресс и награды для игры на ManyPlay.
description.en: ManyPlay client progress actions and verified level results.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay client progress actions and verified level results. Select mod-progress when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.ru: Публичный календарь событий и входящие события игрока.
description.en: ManyPlay planned public scheduling calendar and player inbox.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay planned public scheduling calendar and player inbox. Select mod-scheduling when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.ru: Входы в функции для игры на ManyPlay.
description.en: ManyPlay HUD registry: feature icons with badges, layout from configs scope ui.hud.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay HUD registry: feature icons with badges, layout from configs scope ui.hud. Select mod-hud when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.ru: Нейтральные компоненты SDK и окна ManyPlay ID.
description.en: Neutral UI components and window contracts with a fixed ManyPlay ID presentation.

modules.llmDescription: Neutral UI components and window contracts with a fixed ManyPlay ID presentation. Game presentation is selected separately with a skin bundle.

description.ru: Обновления в реальном времени для игры на ManyPlay.

modules.llmDescription: ManyPlay realtime message bus (E102). Select mod-realtime when the game needs this SDK capability. Read the linked module documentation for methods and events.

description.en: Daily reward calendar entry and ready badge backed by progress.

modules.llmDescription: Daily reward calendar entry and ready badge backed by progress.

label.ru: Показывать окно при входе в игру

help.ru: Ключ записи progress (цепочка входов, reset day). Состояние и выдачу ведёт сервер; награды, цикл и пропуск записываются в неё из этой карточки
help.en: Key of the progress record (login chain, reset day). The server owns state and grants; rewards, cycle and miss rule are published into it from this card

label.en: Reset the cycle on a missed day

help.ru: reset.onMiss записи progress: включено — после пропуска цикл начинается заново, выключено — прогресс сохраняется
help.en: reset.onMiss of the progress record: on — a missed day restarts the cycle, off — progress is kept
